data_scope: Complete Train development blocks only; not Calibration, Validation or Final
hypothesis: The unchanged fitted admission-birth model replicates its full-G5 prediction improvement and factual paired-difference accuracy on additional complete Train blocks.
release_convention: interval-censored Gateway release upper endpoint, unchanged
primary_metric: Full Good-count G5 MAE, equal-weight episode/cell within independent seed block, using the frozen diagnostic implementation
secondary_metrics: paired factual difference MAE and zero predictor
replication_rule: Report whether G5 MAE is below all frozen comparators separately on BOTH evaluation blocks; report paired-G5 error against zero separately. This is a descriptive development gate, not a statistical guarantee or same-state action ranking.
eligibility: Exactly the frozen v5 diagnostic's grid/history/qualified path/Train support/pending action/full target checks, shared by all its comparators
source_binding: Explicit recovery729 registry and checksum ledger; confirmed holds must retain ACK/run/domain/budget/version/operation binding
no_changes: No horizon, scenario, bin, weight, seed or metric search
No selective removal of unfavorable eligible results
gpu_scope: Existing single authorized RTX4090 identification run continues unchanged; this replication itself is CPU trace replay
